SYMPTOM: Maestro keyboard setup flow failed — Settings > General doesn't show 'Keyboard' immediately; 'Keyboard' as a standalone top-level settings entry doesn't exist
CAUSE: iOS 26 reorganized Settings — keyboard settings moved deeper, and 'Keyboards' shows as a row with a count like 'Keyboards, 3'
FIX: Navigate Settings > General (scroll down) > 'Keyboard' section > tap 'Keyboards, N' row (index 1, not 0 which is nav bar) > 'Add New Keyboard...'
KEYBOARD NAME: Shows as 'Whisnap' in the Add New Keyboard picker, but 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' once installed in the list
FULL ACCESS: iOS 26 removed the system confirmation alert — toggling 'Allow Full Access' works silently, no 'Allow' button to tap
PREVENT: Use conditional runFlow blocks to handle already-installed state
